notes.title: v0.25.0 MEMORY OPTIMIZATION
notes.content:
[b]NEW[/b]
-Settings: Low Memory Usage toggle
-Mixer: You can now enable/disable which cards will repeat their sequence.
-Sessions: You can now play a preset from the Sessions section even if it's not open in the Mixer.

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
-Mixer: Now you don't have to wait for your sounds to load, they'll now load when needed.
-General visual improvements.

[b]FIXES[/b]
-Mixer | Sfx Pad: Sometimes without moving the files, tracks get lost and only "File not found" is displayed.
-Mixer | Sfx Pad: Sound files keep hanging, saying "loading" but never load.

[b]NOTES[/b]

[b]LOW MEMORY USAGE[/b]

We improved the way sounds are loaded into the mixer. They will now load when needed and unload after they finish playing, reducing the impact on memory.

Even when you have "Low memory usage" disabled, you may notice a reduction on the memory impact. But even so we don't recommend you to use very long tracks with this setting.

In the mixer, when "Low memory usage" is enabled, sounds will not be loaded into memory, but they'll be played as a stream, reducing memory consumption to a minimum, but because they are decoded in real time, You will notice a slight delay in your input and sounds will not loop properly.

In the Sfx Pad, when "Low memory usage" is enabled, sounds will be loaded at the time they're triggered, so you may notice a slight delay. This delay may vary depending on the duration of the track. Longer tracks will take longer to be decoded.

[b]RECOMMENDATIONS[/b]

If you're using huge tracks, we recommend you to enable Low Memory Usage, this way you won't have to wait for your sounds to load completely.

If you want to achieve a perfect loop, You have to:
1. In Settings tab disable "Low memory usage".
2. Go to the Mixer.
3. Open the "Sequence" containing the sound you want to loop.
4. Enable the little "Loop" button placed at the right of the sound.

notes.title: New release v0.20.0
notes.content:
[h1]NEW RELEASE v0.20.0[/h1]

Hi everyone!

We've been fixing a lot of bugs and implementing new cool features and improvements.

Also, you'll find that we added a sample session for the Tavern pack with two presets out of the box, hope you like it!

[h2][b]RELEASE NOTES[/b][/h2]
[b]NEW[/b]
- Library:
-- Navigate using arrows.
-- Select and tag multiple files.
-- Copy/Cut and Paste selection.
-- Now it's possible to import folders.
-- Support for new file formats: mp2, aiff.
- Sessions: Pre-made sample Session using Tavern pack.

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
- Preset Mixer: Delay interval assignation.
- Library: Selecting a filter now searches for ALL files with the tag.

[b]FIXES[/b]
- Sessions: Error reading sessions data.
- Mixer: Saving preset resets the name of the preset to the previous name.
- Library:
-- Not possible to assign an image when a file has just been imported.
-- Root folder adopting the name of the last sub-folder renamed.
-- When a new image is imported, it replaces the image for all files inside the folder.

Thanks a lot for using RPG Sounds and for your feedback and patience!

notes.title: Quick update regarding Online Play
notes.content:
Hi everyone, this is an update for Mac users. Now the Online Play is working and you should be able to stream your sessions to your remote players. 

We are working to fix the Online Play for Windows users. Thanks for your patience.
